item.name: Ai
item.description: AI assistance. Any signed-in user may call it; it never saves anything.

description.content:
Rewrites a rough task description so it is grammatically correct, clearer, more professional and
actionable, and expands it when it is very short. Returns the original, the suggested text and up
to three notes about missing information. Nothing is saved

**Roles:** Admin, ProjectManager, TeamMember

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Registration and session endpoints. They are anonymous because a caller has no valid access token
yet, or it has expired. The refresh token travels only in the `stms_refresh` HttpOnly cookie.

description.content: Creates a new account. New accounts are always team members.
Signs in. Returns an access token and sets the refresh-token cookie.
Exchanges the refresh-token cookie for a new access token, and rotates the cookie.
Signs out: revokes the refresh token and clears its cookie. Always succeeds.

item.name: Dashboard

description.content:
Gets task counts by status and priority, overdue and pending counts, and the tasks due in the
next upcomingDays days (clamped to 1–30). Admins see everything, project
managers their own projects, team members their own tasks.

owns the project.

info.name: Smart Task Management API
info.description:
Generated from docs/api/openapi.json (Swashbuckle) with openapi-to-postmanv2, then post-processed.

1. Select the "Smart Task - Local" environment and fill in email and password (e.g. a seeded or bootstrap admin).
2. Run Auth > Login. The test script stores the access token in {{accessToken}}; Postman keeps the refresh cookie.
3. Every other request sends Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}. Run Auth > Refresh token when it expires (15 min).
4. Create project / Create task / Create user store {{projectId}}, {{taskId}} and {{userId}} for the requests that follow.
